title: Racials
description: All 37 racials, counted once when both Skyborne factions share the name. Combat value first. Treasure-tracking is not a combat racial.
basis: Client racial text in the vendored races file, the Icy Veins race guide (Sep 28, 2026), and the Sep 24 Eureka! nerf. Gnome is not S. The old 50% cost cut is gone.

entries.note: Clears every stun. The battleground button for anyone who dies in a stun lock.
Breaks Charm, Fear and Sleep. Fear is still a battleground win condition.
10% Attack Power and Spell Power for 15 seconds. Works on the new Orc Mage.
Drops bleed, poison and disease, and cuts physical damage 10% for 8 seconds.
Breaks roots and snares and grants a short immunity. The second Blink.
Stun duration reduced 20%. Always on. The reason Orc stays the PvP melee pick.
10% spell and attack speed for 10 seconds. Haste on a button, for healers and casters.
10% crit on every spell and attack for 15 seconds. The largest damage cooldown that is not a weapon buff.
Stuns up to 5 enemies for 2 seconds. A tank and flag-carrier peel that is not a talent.
10% cheaper and 10% stronger on the next 3 abilities. Was up to 50% before Sep 24. Not S.
10% chance for casters, 5% for melee, to drain up to 5% health. No longer breaks crowd control.
Stealth detection for 20 seconds. The anti-Rogue button on a 3-minute cooldown.
Drops you out of combat attention. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are also harder to see in stealth.
5% health and 1% hit. Both numbers are live on every pull, which is why tanks take Tauren.
2% crit with a sword, spells included. The best weapon racial, and it does nothing for daggers.
1% dodge, 2% movement speed, and stealth detection as if you were 1 level higher.
Clears curses and banes, then 15% less magic damage for 8 seconds.
Up to 30% movement speed while you keep moving. The leveling racial. Damage drops the stacks.
5% more mana, rage or energy. Quiet, and it is up on every pull.
7% health and 7% mana every 2 seconds off a humanoid or undead corpse. The solo drink.
5% Spirit. Real for a Holy Priest stacking Spiritual Guidance. Nothing for a Warrior.
10% more health regen, and 10% of it continues in combat. A trickle, not a potion.
Channels 50% of your health back over 6 seconds. Any hit cancels it.
A 10-second glide on a 2-minute cooldown. Pathing, not a fight button. Shared by both Skyborne.
5% damage to beasts. Strong while leveling, narrow in a raid.
Same 5% against beasts, on the Alliance side. Same limit.
1% haste to spells, melee and ranged. Always on, and it is 1%. Shared by both Skyborne.
1% crit with an axe. Half of Sword Specialization, and only on that weapon.
1% crit with a mace. Take it if the weapon is a mace. Do not pick the race for it.
5% damage to elementals. Narrow. Shared by both Skyborne, so it is one entry.
20% fewer engineering failures. A profession racial, not a combat one.
75% faster as a corpse. Useful, and you had to die to use it.
Health and mana regen, 15 seconds if you miss the ley line and 15 minutes if you find one.
Movement speed from an elemental convergence. 30 seconds if you do not find one.
Shows treasure on the minimap. No combat value.
Duplicates an herb. Sep 24 made it ask for a player level. Not a fight racial.
Breath lasts 300% longer. One zone, no fight.
